**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 (the only Customer-binding audit right; § 23 has no operative text) sits at the **preferred** position on every material term:

- **Frequency:** no more than once in any twelve-month period (22.1)
- **Notice:** at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, without unreasonable disruption (22.1)
- **Manner:** off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1)
- **Cost:** Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2)
- **System access:** Vendor and its auditor expressly may not access Customer systems directly, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information (22.2)

Section 22.3 is a further benefit to us — audit findings are Customer Confidential Information, usable only to enforce the Agreement, with a copy of the final report and finality on payment of any shortfall.
